field_units.seq: positive integer event index starting at 1 within one cell
field_units.monotonic_ns: nonnegative integer nanoseconds since cell start; nondecreasing, equal timestamps allowed
field_units.counts: nonnegative integer occurrences, never floating-point and never JSON booleans
field_units.identities: exact strings or structured keys, not numeric measurements
field_units.timestamps: UTC ISO-8601 with local offset stored in administrative manifest
field_units.resource_wall_seconds: finite nonnegative seconds; diagnostic, not a native correctness threshold beyond approved hard limits
field_units.drain_timeout_seconds: finite numeric seconds, exactly 2.0 (exactly representable), zero tolerance; store each actual call separately
field_units.system_exit_code: integer injected code 0, distinct from the parent process exit code; null on normal return
field_units.callback_counts: integer actual callback receipts per op token; never replace with perform_pending_operations call count

equality_policy.identity_count_enum_string_policy: Exact, type-checked equality; reject bool-as-int, coercion, trimming, case folding, omitted namespaces and missing required fields.
equality_policy.float_policy: No approximate native comparisons. Numeric values must be finite; NaN/Inf in a numeric field invalidate collection rather than demonstrate a target bug. Do not apply floating-point checks to strings, exception messages or unavailable fields.
equality_policy.cross_process: Do not compare memory addresses, repr object IDs, PIDs or random temporary path prefixes across processes. Native object equality is evaluated within its cell; serialize booleans plus semantic keys.
equality_policy.order: Use strictly increasing contiguous seq, not strict timestamp inequalities. No reordering to manufacture expected history.
equality_policy.adjustment: No result-dependent threshold, message, namespace, timing-window or comparator changes.

failure_classification.expected_violation: An evaluator-captured predeclared native violation may be COMPLETED / VIOLATED with process exit 0. Exit code alone, a crash or text PASS is never the oracle.
failure_classification.invalid_input_or_import: Missing dependency, illegal control construction, stale app/module state, collector failure or fixture exhaustion is never the target bug.
failure_classification.unresolved_exception: Record full type/message/traceback and phase. Unexpected exceptions with intact capture are UNRESOLVED pending classification, not an expected native violation; true collector/process failures remain separate.
failure_classification.valid_no_contrast: If intact four-cell native execution yields no predefined before/after trigger contrast, retain NATIVE_CONTRAST_NOT_ESTABLISHED, even if both versions satisfy or both violate.
failure_classification.qualification: Only intact identity/logs, both lawful controls SATISFIED, before-trigger VIOLATED as specified, and after-trigger SATISFIED can support NATIVE_FIXED_PAIR_VERIFIED.
failure_classification.g1_history: Append G2/G3 evidence; do not overwrite G1 rank or SOURCE_PAIR_VERIFIED.

evidence_outputs.segregation: Keep before/after, trigger/control, correct-answer and oracle-result labels in administrative/oracle files, separate from raw native trace and any eventual G4 method input. G4 is not implemented here.
evidence_outputs.artifact_integrity: Preserve partial attempts, full raw messages and stream truncation flags; every result references immutable protocol/environment/source/collector identities.

Never run Celery4661 or Django11110/ticket26552, touch SQLA5737/SQLA4664 evidence, access production services, P09/Docker/WSL, or perform LCMA/strong-baseline/G4 work.

native_property.execution_vs_check_count: perform_pending_operations invocation count is a mechanism witness, not the duplicate-callback oracle. native_property.exit_contract: Normal-history cells return None; exceptional-history cells propagate the injected SystemExit with integer code 0. Capturing SystemExit is expected in both trigger cells and never alone proves the defect.
native_property.narrow_claim: Only two nonthrowing callbacks pending before this single no-hub sync-loop exit window. No claim about broker ACKs, recursive task duplication rates, asynchronous hubs, gevent/eventlet workers, callbacks enqueued during teardown or the separate Consumer.shutdown fix.
